info.title: Capigo Public API
info.description: Public API documentation for Capigo Developer Platform. Integrate your external tools with Capigo tasks, boards, and members. See `apps/platform/docs/api-v1-changelog.md` for version history.

get.description:
Paginated product feed for external catalog synchronization.

Supports delta sync: pass `updated_since` (ISO 8601 UTC) to receive only products changed after that timestamp; omit for a full sync. Results are ordered by `updated_at` ascending so clients can checkpoint progress reliably.

Alternatively, pass `ids` (comma-separated UUIDs, max 50) to fetch a specific subset of products by ID — useful after `POST`/`PUT` or to refresh a local cache for known items. `ids` AND-composes with `updated_since` and pagination, and is tenant-scoped (foreign IDs are silently filtered, never leaked).

Deleted products are included with `is_deleted: true` so consumers can remove them from their local catalog. Each product's `variants` array contains only active variants.

Internal fields (cost, audit metadata, tenancy identifiers) are omitted from the response.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant to scope the request to.

parameters.name: updated_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime. When provided, only products updated at or after this timestamp are returned — including products where an active variant was updated. Example: `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of product UUIDs to restrict the response to. Max 50 IDs per request. Foreign IDs (belonging to other tenants) are silently filtered. Returns `400 INVALID_IDS` for malformed input (non-UUID token, empty value, more than 50 IDs).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search fragment (2-500 characters). Matches case-insensitive substring against product name, variant name, variant SKU, and variant barcode.

X-Server-Time.description: ISO 8601 server timestamp at query execution — use as `updated_since` for the next delta sync call.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (e.g. malformed updated_since, malformed ids, or out-of-range limit)

post.description:
Create a new product within the tenant identified by `X-Tenant-Code`.

Supports two creation modes:
- **Simple mode**: omit `options` and `variants`. A single default variant is created from `sku`, `barcode`, and `price` on the product body.
- **Variant mode**: supply 1–3 entries in `options` (e.g. Color, Size) plus a `variants` array. Each variant must populate `option1`/`option2`/`option3` with the chosen value for the corresponding option (positions match `options[]` order). The backend does not auto-generate the cartesian product — clients are responsible for sending the exact list of variants to create.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant to scope the request to.

sku.description: Simple mode only: SKU for the auto-created default variant. Ignored when `options`/`variants` are provided.

barcode.description: Simple mode only: barcode for the auto-created default variant.

price.description: Simple mode only: price for the auto-created default variant.

options.description: Variant mode: defines the option axes (e.g. Color, Size). Up to 3 options; their order determines which `option1/2/3` slot each value maps to.

variants.description: Variant mode: explicit list of variants to create. Each variant must set `option1`/`option2`/`option3` matching the values declared in `options[]` (by position).

option1.description: Value for `options[0]`. Required when `options[0]` is defined.

400.description: Validation error or invalid product payload

403.description: Tenant access denied or insufficient permissions

put.description: Update the core details of a product. Variant-level fields (`sku`, `barcode`, `price`, option values) are intentionally **not** editable through this endpoint — use `PUT /pcms/products/{id}/variants` to modify variants.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant that owns the product.

schema.description: At least one field must be provided.

403.description: Tenant access denied or insufficient permissions

404.description: Product not found in the specified tenant

put.description:
Upsert variants of a product. The request body is an array of items.

- Items **with** `variant_id` (UUID) → update the existing variant.
- Items **without** `variant_id` → create a new variant (`name` is required; `option1`/`option2`/`option3` should match the product's option matrix).

A single request may mix create and update items. Variants **not** included in the payload are left untouched (this endpoint does not delete variants). Unknown `variant_id` values return 404.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant that owns the product.

variant_id.description: Omit to create a new variant; include to update an existing one.

name.description: Variant display name. Required when creating (variant_id omitted). For matrix products use `"<opt1> / <opt2>"`.

option1.description: Used when creating a new variant on a matrix product.

400.description: Validation error or invalid variants payload

403.description: Tenant access denied or insufficient permissions

404.description: Product or one of the supplied variants not found in the specified tenant

get.description: Paginated, name-sorted list of brands for a tenant. Use `?q=` for name-contains search to resolve brand names to UUIDs before creating products.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Tenant to scope the request to. Required.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name contains filter (case-insensitive, max 200 chars). Empty or absent means no filter.

200.description: Paginated list of brands sorted by name ascending

400.description: Missing X-Tenant-Code or invalid query parameters

get.description: Paginated, name-sorted list of categories for a tenant. Use `?q=` for name-contains search.

200.description: Paginated list of categories sorted by name ascending

400.description: Missing X-Tenant-Code or invalid query parameters

get.description: Paginated, name-sorted list of product types for a tenant. Use `?q=` for name-contains search.

200.description: Paginated list of product types sorted by name ascending

400.description: Missing X-Tenant-Code or invalid query parameters

get.description: Paginated, name-sorted list of product units for a tenant. Use `?q=` for name-contains search.

200.description: Paginated list of product units sorted by name ascending

400.description: Missing X-Tenant-Code or invalid query parameters

get.description: Paginated flat list of product variants. Accepts an optional `barcode_prefix` to filter variants whose barcode starts with the given string. Useful for finding the highest barcode already assigned in a prefix namespace to auto-increment without collisions.

parameters.name: X-Tenant-Code
parameters.description: Code of the tenant to scope the request to.

parameters.name: barcode_prefix
parameters.description: Optional barcode prefix to filter variants. Only variants whose barcode starts with this value are returned.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order. Use `-barcode` for descending (to find highest barcode in a prefix range) or `barcode` for ascending.

X-Server-Time.description: ISO 8601 server timestamp at query execution.
